name: Machine Seated Alternating Close-Grip Row
steps: Sit in a seated row machine with independent lever arms, press your chest against the pad, and grasp the narrow neutral-grip handles with both arms extended.
Pull one handle straight back toward your ribs while keeping the opposite arm extended forward.
Extend the first arm slowly back to the start, then pull the opposite handle back.
Continue alternating arms on each repetition while keeping your chest square against the pad.
tips: Prevent your torso from twisting side to side as you pull one handle at a time.
Keep your elbow close to your body and squeeze your shoulder blade back on every pull.
